steps.summary: Ten loose font sizes and four weights became one five-step ladder, with sentence-case labels and figures that line up.

changes.what: The page title comes down to the product ceiling, set in the heading weight
Distinct text sizes on the page
Font weights in use
Uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrows become sentence-case labels
The dialog title no longer outranks the page's section headings
changes.after: 16px, the same as every section heading

changes.what: Buttons set as interface text, not body text
Field labels lead by weight and tier instead of size
Numbers that align or identify use tabular figures
changes.after: 3 (seat count, time-zone offsets, workspace ID with slashed zero)

steps.summary: Every edge and label now clears its contrast floor in both themes, and colour is kept for things that need a person rather than things that are done.

changes.what: Input and select edges you can actually see
Text on dark-mode primary buttons
Keyboard focus on fields is a real ring, not a faint halo
"Unsaved changes" is readable
changes.after: ink text 8.17:1 with an amber dot (#915c08, 5.38:1)

changes.what: The quietest text tier gains margin
Connected services and met password rules stop shouting green
changes.before: green badge on a green tint; green filled ticks
changes.after: neutral badge with a filled dot vs a ring; ink tick on a neutral circle

changes.what: Error messages keep their words in ink; only the icon is red
changes.after: sentence in ink, 8.17:1, with a red icon beside it

changes.what: The avatar's three-stop blue gradient becomes one person colour

steps.summary: Five boxed cards became sections stacked under their headings, with spacing that groups and one table style for the notification grid.

changes.what: Settings sections no longer sit in boxes
changes.after: 0 boxes; each section opened by its heading

changes.what: Space groups a heading with its section
The notifications grid gets its own table frame
changes.before: rows running to a card's edges
changes.after: one 0.5px frame at 8px radius, tinted header row

changes.what: Corner radii step down to the product ladder
Dividers drawn as hairlines
The rule under the profile photo is replaced by space
Stacking order comes from a named ladder
The field grid folds by the width of its column, not the window

steps.summary: Shadows went from decoration on everything to three named levels, and the frosted top bar became solid.

changes.what: Things that sit in the page stop casting shadows
changes.before: shadows on 5 cards, every input and button, 3 logo tiles and the active nav item
changes.after: none; only the top bar, toast and dialog lift

changes.what: The top bar is opaque
Provider logos lose their tiles
The delete dialog is the system's dialog
changes.before: 44px red warning-icon circle above the title
changes.after: no icon; the danger sits on the Delete account button

changes.what: The dialog's scrim
In dark mode the dialog lifts by getting lighter
Shadow recipes
changes.before: 3 tokens plus inline stacks on the avatar, knob, nav item and primary button; dark md identical to sm
changes.after: 3 levels (raised, floating, overlay) per theme, one light

steps.summary: Ad-hoc timings became a four-step ladder with one curve, the dialog now closes as deliberately as it opens, and reduced motion keeps its signals.

changes.what: Durations on a ladder set by how much changes
One easing curve
changes.after: 1 standard cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); ease-out for colour; ease-in for exits

changes.what: The dialog animates out, faster than in
The current section is one marker that travels
changes.before: two 150ms fades (old link out, new link in)
changes.after: one marker sliding 150ms down the rail

changes.what: Switches snap at the product tempo
Pressing a button
changes.after: pressed surface at once (0ms), no travel

changes.what: Reduced motion keeps a substitute instead of switching everything off
changes.after: dialog and toast fade without travel; marker keeps a 100ms tween

steps.summary: Toasts now appear only when they add something, disconnecting can be undone, and deleting the account behaves like the serious action it is.

changes.what: Saves stop doubling up with a toast
changes.after: 0; the status line beside the button says it

changes.what: Disconnect acts at once and can be undone
changes.before: 700ms spinner, then a toast with no way back
changes.after: immediate, with an Undo toast for 6s

changes.what: The delete dialog stays open while it works
changes.after: "Deleting…", buttons disabled, Escape blocked until done

changes.what: The confirmation says exactly what is lost
changes.after: profile, personal tasks and comments deleted; owned projects move to an admin; can't be undone

changes.what: An email error clears as you fix it
changes.before: stays red on every keystroke until the address is valid
changes.after: clears on typing, re-checked on blur and save

changes.what: The ⌘K hint in the search field works
